correctness.rationale: Under I(0)=A(0)=W(0)=0 with E(0)>0 and s0=S(0)/N<1, the source final-size equation is log(s0/x)=R0(1-x), 0<x<=s0. f(0+)=+infinity and f(s0)=-R0(1-s0)<0; strict convexity ensures a unique physical root on the decreasing part and R0*x<1. Implicit derivative dx/dR0=(1-x)/(R0-1/x)<0 everywhere R0>0. At exactly zero seeding s0=1, ODE selects x=1, whereas lower root 0.7001358120 at R0=1.188808 is only a small-positive-seed limit. Independently computed the root and strict derivative for four seeded s0 values.
